source: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
title: Guiding Principle 6 (GP-6): NBA Approval Prerequisite before Grant of Patent
raw_text: Guiding Principle 6: In every patent application involving Indian biological resources or traditional knowledge, the Controller shall not grant the patent until the applicant produces proof of permission/approval from the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) in accordance with Section 6 of the Biological Diversity Act, 2002. A formal objection shall be raised in the First Examination Report (FER) requiring submission of NBA Form III approval.
guidance: Patent examination can proceed through hearings, but the patent certificate will be legally withheld until the applicant files Form 3 with NBA and submits the NBA approval certificate to the Patent Office.
